mapper.sql: SELECT a.activity_id, a.vendor_id, v.business_name AS vendor_business_name, a.title, a.description, a.location, a.price, a.registration_start_date, a.registration_end_date, a.activity_start_date, a.activity_end_date, a.daily_capacity, a.status, a.created_at, a.updated_at FROM activity a JOIN vendor v ON v.vendor_id = a.vendor_id
mapper.select: WHERE a.vendor_id = #{vendorId} ORDER BY a.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO activity (vendor_id, title, description, location, price, registration_start_date, registration_end_date, activity_start_date, activity_end_date, daily_capacity, status) VALUES (#{vendorId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{location}, #{price}, #{registrationStartDate}, #{registrationEndDate}, #{activityStartDate}, #{activityEndDate}, #{dailyCapacity}, 'ACTIVE')
mapper.update: UPDATE activity SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, location = #{location}, price = #{price}, registration_start_date = #{registrationStartDate}, registration_end_date = #{registrationEndDate}, activity_start_date = #{activityStartDate}, activity_end_date = #{activityEndDate}, daily_capacity = #{dailyCapacity}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} AND vendor_id = #{vendorId}
